body:
New research project `research/fiat-shamir-grinding` (MIT): with free retries, a cheater's profit against hash-derived audit challenges is exactly G − c/p; deterrence needs ln(G/c)·T/k opened steps versus ln2·T/k for a beacon (10×–60×); stake is irrelevant under grinding; closed-form optimal challenge proof-of-work x* = v/λ_p − c0. Includes code, 12 tests, experiments, white paper, portfolio page and README entries.
